definitions.constructive pair: a two-photon block on a kite edge: |perm M| = 2, det M = 0, label coincidence (perm M / 4)^2 = 1/4 for indistinguishable photons against 1/8 for distinguishable ones
definitions.suppressed pair: a two-photon block on a strut or an (l, l^8) pair: perm M = 0, |det M| = 2, label coincidence 0 for indistinguishable photons against 1/8 for distinguishable ones

preregistered.observable: per job, the two-click samples (min_detected_photons 2, threshold detectors) by mode pair; the label coincidence is the fraction of two-click samples with one click on each label mode
preregistered.ideal: pair_ideal lists P(a, b) for indistinguishable and distinguishable photons; a source of indistinguishability V mixes them as V P_ind + (1 - V) P_dist before threshold conditioning, so an edge block reads (1 + V)/8 and a strut or non-kite block (1 - V)/8 on the label pair
preregistered.calibration: the hom job, a balanced splitter on the same two sources, reads P(1, 1) = (1 - V)/2 and fixes V for every pair block of the series
preregistered.hardware_report: the edge minus strut label-coincidence difference against V/4 from the hom job, the sign of perm M as the classifier of each block, and every mode-pair frequency against pair_ideal at the fitted V, with Wilson 95% intervals
preregistered.falsifier: a strut or non-kite block whose label coincidence exceeds the edge blocks' at the fitted V, or an edge minus strut difference outside V/4 by more than 4.5 standard errors
